Home.transitionDescription: Design clarifies the experience. Code brings it to life.
Home.projectShowcaseHint: Scroll to explore · Select a work to preview
Home.workProcessDescription:
Four clear stages take a project from understanding the problem to launch and iteration.
We stay in touch and agree on each next step.
Home.processChartLabel: Relative stages of the workflow; timing varies by project
Home.processChartNote: Relative stages only; the pace depends on each project.

processStages.title: Understand the problem
processStages.description: Start with the goals, context, and constraints to find the problem worth solving.

processStages.title: Set direction
processStages.description: Map the needs and user journey, then agree on what to build.

processStages.title: Design and build
processStages.description: Shape the experience and implement the features until the idea becomes a useful product.

processStages.title: Launch and iterate
processStages.description: Launch, learn from feedback, and keep improving as real needs emerge.

Privacy.title: Privacy notice
Privacy.description: What information is recorded when you sign in, how long it is kept, and how to request deletion.
Privacy.scopeAnonymous: Browsing anonymously does not create visitor records.
Privacy.scopeAccount: When you sign in with Google, we store your email address, display name, first and most recent sign-in times, and the Google account and session data needed to authenticate you.
Privacy.scopeVisits: When you open an article or an on-site project while signed in, we record the first and most recent visit times and the number of visits.
Privacy.retentionBody: Visit history is kept for {months} months after your most recent visit and then removed automatically. Account details remain until you ask us to delete them. Sessions are valid for seven days and are revoked when you sign out.
Privacy.deletionBody: You can request deletion of your account and its associated sign-in and visit records at any time.
Privacy.deletionContactFallback: Please use a public contact channel on this website to request deletion.
